PLEASE CONTACT YOUR CREST SPONSORED MEMBER/CUSTODIAN DIRECTLY FOR FURTHER INFORMATION ON THE CUSTODY PROCESS AND WHETHER OR NOT THEY REQUIRE SEPARATE INSTRUCTIONS FROM YOU
